title: Viscose Carousel
description: A ring of project cards drawn as one WebGL shader: the cards melt into each other and string threads of honey as the ring turns, with a cursor drop, momentum and snapping.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards in ring order, 3 to 18: { title, image, discipline?, year? }. Images must be same-origin or served with CORS.

props.name: theme
props.description: The room: bone ink on near-black paper, or ink on warm paper.

props.name: heading
props.description: The intro heading drawn while the ring forms.

props.name: cursorLabel
props.description: The word the cursor's drop opens to over a card.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: A card was opened: clicked at the front, turned to by a click on a side card, or Enter.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: The card at the front changed.

props.name: params
props.description: Any of upstream's tunables (geometry, entry timing, goo, threads, glass lip, bead, fonts). Read when the ring is built; a change rebuilds it.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the carousel.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Replaces the static picture shown before the first frame, without WebGL 2 and under reduced motion.

a11y: The ring is a focusable listbox: arrow keys turn it one card at a time, Home and End go to the ends, Enter or Space opens the front card; each option names the project, its discipline and year.
A polite live region announces the card that comes to rest; the canvas, the index column and the melting labels are hidden from assistive tech.
Under reduced motion, without WebGL 2 and before the first frame it shows a static arc of the cards with the front project's name; the keys still move through the projects there.
usage: <ViscoseCarousel items={[{ title: "Emberline", image: "/work/emberline.jpg", discipline: "Photography", year: "2026" }]} onOpen={(item) => router.push(`/work/${item.title}`)} className="h-dvh w-full" />
docs:
Installed `ViscoseCarousel` (with its engine, Motion tweens and shaders) in `components/ui/`, plus the `render-loop` helper in `lib/`. Render `<ViscoseCarousel items={items} onOpen={(item) => ...} className="h-dvh w-full" />`; it fills its box, so size it with `className`.

Each item is `{ title, image, discipline?, year? }`; images are drawn into a WebGL texture, so they must be same-origin or served with CORS. Up to 18 cards. Tune anything with `params` (for example `params={{ goo: 50 }}`). Rendering pauses off screen and in hidden tabs; under reduced motion or without WebGL 2 a static picture shows instead.

Needs `three` and `motion` (installed) and, for TypeScript, `@types/three`. Ported from Yousuf-developer/Viscose-carousel (MIT, copyright 2026 Yousuf Soomro); the license text is in each file.
